caption: The drawing is rendered in monochromatic shades of gray and black on a beige background. It depicts three views of a mechanical object. The central and largest illustration shows a symmetrical device that consists of two large, conical sections joined at their bases by a cylindrical band. The lower half has three protruding arms spaced evenly around its circumference, and beneath this section are three vertically oriented blades or fins that are slightly curved. Above the arms are three box-like structures attached to the central cylinder, with visible mechanisms and components inside, possibly gears or rods, all enclosed within thin, perforated plates. The device is dotted with rivets or bolts along seams and edges. In the upper left corner, a simplified, technical line drawing of the object is presented from a side view, focusing on the external outlines and internal vertical structure with dashed and solid lines. In the bottom left corner, there is a top-down view emphasizing the triangular arrangement of the arms, shown in both solid lines and dashed construction lines, with a small ruler for scale. The artist’s signature, "H. BADER," is located in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Oil Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
